footer: This email was sent by MeetApp. If you didn't expect it, you can ignore it.
ignoreIfNotYou: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email. Nobody can sign in without this code.

intro.sign-up: Type this code in MeetApp to confirm your email address.
intro.sign-in: Type this code in MeetApp to sign in.
intro.reset: Type this code in MeetApp to choose a new password.

code.validity: The code works for 15 minutes, once.

invitation.subject: {{inviter}} invited you to {{workspace}} on MeetApp
invitation.intro: {{inviter}} invited you to join {{workspace}} on MeetApp as {{role}}.
invitation.howTo: Open MeetApp and sign in or create an account with {{email}}. Your invitation is waiting there.

joinRequest.subject: {{person}} asked to join {{workspace}}
joinRequest.intro: {{person}} ({{email}}) asked to join {{workspace}} with the join link or code.
joinRequest.howTo: Open MeetApp, go to Requests and invitations, and approve or reject the request.

subject.rejected: Your request to join {{workspace}} was not approved

intro.approved: Your request to join {{workspace}} was approved. Open MeetApp to find it in your workspace list.
intro.rejected: Your request to join {{workspace}} was not approved. You can ask an admin of {{workspace}} for an invitation.

someoneTried.subject: Someone tried to create a MeetApp account with your email
someoneTried.intro: Someone tried to create a new MeetApp account with this email address. You already have an account, so nothing was changed.
someoneTried.howTo: To sign in, open MeetApp. Forgot your password? Choose Forgot password on the sign-in screen.
someoneTried.notYou: If it wasn't you, you don't need to do anything.

joinMe.subject: {{inviter}} wants to chat with you on MeetApp
joinMe.intro: {{inviter}} invited you to MeetApp, an app for chats, calls and meetings.
joinMe.howTo: Create a free account with {{email}}. Then {{inviter}} can send you a chat request.
